verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for an observability SaaS that stores customer telemetry, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of retention periods, retention configuration, or data deletion. Community mentions of turning off log collection (via environment variables or the Data Management Hub 'log settings') are ingestion controls, an adjacent feature that is not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
